notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
You control a basic land.
description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible by any method.
Activate the basic land by tapping it to add {1}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon and creating a 1/1 Squirrel token.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Acorn Catapult.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squirrel token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat from step 2.
